recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up is needed for FHIR-42081 unless a separate final issue changes the later device[x] modeling or binding details.
issue_request: FHIR-42081 is an Applied/Persuasive FHIR-core Specimen technical correction from OO, raised in R5 and applied for R6. It requested changing Specimen.collection.device from the copied method wording, "A coded value specifying the technique that is used to perform the procedure.", to "A coded value specifying the device that is used to perform the procedure."
initial_application: Git commit 458a4c4be551040f5493ca74b0cd7d5e4746f40a explicitly applied FHIR-42081 by changing source/specimen/structuredefinition-Specimen.xml from the old technique wording to the approved device wording. source/fhir.ini keeps Specimen active in the current build.
additional_context: OO minutes for 2023-10-02 list FHIR-42081 as Persuasive with "Will fix". A later Specimen source change for FHIR-39389 changed the element path to Specimen.collection.device[x] and adjusted types while preserving the corrected definition. Jira search also surfaced the earlier FHIR-33163 add-collection.device work and later Triaged FHIR-54488 binding-mismatch issue, but neither changes this definition decision.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The active current source has Specimen.collection.method retaining the technique definition and Specimen.collection.device[x] using the approved device definition, and current-source searches did not find an active copied device definition needing correction.
